title: Balance at a glance
short: The closing balance, the change since the opening balance and a reference US-dollar value, up front.

title: Your statement in 60 seconds
short: A one-minute narrated walkthrough of the customer’s own figures, with captions and chapters.

title: Balance journey
short: An interactive path from opening to closing balance: select any step to see the transactions behind it.

title: Why your balance changed
short: A plain-language account of what moved the balance, with the figures it used.

title: Running balance chart
short: The balance after every posted transaction, with each movement marked.

title: Fees this period
short: Every fee in one place: what it was for, when, and the total.

title: Your largest movement
short: The single biggest movement of the period, picked out and one click from its details.

title: Transaction search and filters
short: Search, filter and sort every transaction, and download the current view.

title: Transaction details
short: Dates, references, fees and masked account details for each transaction.

title: Pending transactions
short: Movements that have started but not posted: listed, labelled and kept out of the balance.

title: Explain with AI
short: A plain-language explanation next to any figure or transaction.

title: Ask about a transaction
short: A guided way to ask YES a question about a specific transaction.

title: Ask YES assistant
short: A built-in assistant that answers questions about this statement.

title: Bank-issued digital dollar basics
short: Short, plain-language explanations of key terms, with examples from the customer’s own figures.

title: Statement balance versus live balance
short: Why the statement balance can differ from the balance in the app today.

title: Reserves, transparency and on-chain reference
short: Where verified reserve and issuer facts would appear, and a sample on-chain reference.

title: Print, PDF and CSV
short: Print the statement of record, or save it as a PDF or a spreadsheet.

title: Help and statement record
short: Contact options, the right route for each problem, feedback and the statement record.

title: Built-in integrity check
short: The statement checks its own numbers and is withheld if they don’t add up.

title: English and Spanish
short: The whole statement in English or Spanish, switchable at any time.

title: Dark mode
short: A light and a dark version that follows the device or the customer’s choice.

title: Accessibility and mobile
short: Designed for WCAG 2.2 AA, with UserWay tools and a layout made for phones.
